tests.what_happened: I did the two halves in the opposite order from the one you gave, because the permission box was already open from the scan test. First, in the "Request permission to access all files" box, I pressed GO TO SET. It took me out of the app into the phone's own page, "All files access", with the app's name and a switch, "Allow access to manage all files", which was off. I did not touch the switch, and I pressed Back. That returned me to the app's main screen, and the box had gone. Then I pressed "Allow Access" in the middle of the main screen. After a moment it took me to exactly the same phone page, "All files access", with the same switch. I pressed Back again without switching anything and was back on the main screen. So both buttons do the same thing and land in the same place. What caught me out is that neither one actually allows access. Both send me to the phone's settings, where I would have to find and flip a switch myself. "Allow Access" made me expect that pressing it would be enough. "GO TO SET" was, in the end, the more honest of the two, but I could not read it with confidence beforehand. I can now tell they are the same step. My concern moved rather than disappeared: the wording of both buttons does not prepare me for being taken out of the app into a phone settings page.
